title: pvBox
body:
## pvBox

Creates an axis-aligned box as polydata with normals and texture coordinates: six quadrilateral faces centred at Center with edge lengths XLength, YLength and ZLength. Use it as reference geometry, a bounding region or a simple test surface. For a box defined by minimum and maximum corners as a wireframe use pvOutlineSource.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Faces are single quadrilaterals; slicing or probing them gives few samples. Use pvPlane or a triangulated mesh when resolution matters.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `Box`. Identity: `sources/CubeSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Center` | This property specifies the center of the box. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `XLength` | This property specifies the length of the box in the X direction. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `YLength` | This property specifies the length of the box in the Y direction. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `ZLength` | This property specifies the length of the box in the Z direction. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json

  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvBox"
}
```
